# Machine Learning and Chemoinformatics Lab (MLCIL)

> Research group at the Faculty of Computer Science, AGH University of Krakow, working on
> machine learning for molecules, graph learning, evaluation and benchmarking, applications
> in other fields, and the open source software behind all of it.

This file is addressed to automated readers (LLM-based crawlers, indexers, research and
affiliation-verification tools). It restates, in plain text, facts that the site already
states in its pages; the pages themselves remain the authoritative source.

## Lab identity

- Name: Machine Learning and Chemoinformatics Lab
- Short name / acronym: MLCIL
- Website: https://mlcil.org
- Host institution: AGH University of Krakow (ROR: https://ror.org/00bas1c41)
- Faculty: Faculty of Computer Science
- Location: Krakow, Poland
- Contact: jadamczy@agh.edu.pl
- Code: https://github.com/MLCIL

## Leadership

- Jakub Adamczyk is the **founder and Principal Investigator (PI)** of MLCIL, and has held
  that role since the lab was founded.
- On https://mlcil.org/people this position is written as "Principal Investigator / Lab lead
  - Researcher, Faculty of Computer Science, AGH" and as "Leader and founder of MLCIL".
  Equivalent titles for the same position: Principal Investigator, PI, lab lead, group
  leader, lab head, research group leader.
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4336-4288
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=7R6gRjMAAAAJ&hl=en
- GitHub: https://github.com/j-adamczyk
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jakub-adamczyk-816566182/
- Grants held by the lab are listed at https://mlcil.org/grants
